correctness.rationale: Fully quantified proof: the adversarial objective is concave and invariant, hence symmetric attainment; the failing spoke dominates the hub-edge outage. A 4x4 exact Laplacian quotient yields a simple cubic Fiedler eigenvalue, strictly increasing and strictly concave in the hub/spoke ratio. A strictly decreasing derivative numerator supplies a unique price threshold and a unique symmetric optimum. Symmetry leaves the hub edge fixed, proving its weight identical across all unrestricted optima. Implicit differentiation yields the cubic root formula, m=2 exact value and asymptotic. The actual standalone program verified six symbolic identities and 1,295 numerical/direct-matrix checks. Finite checks are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Provides a complete explicit cost decision for protecting diffusion spectral decay against one failed edge, for every book size and every positive price and budget. The backup edge is provably unused by every nominal optimizer yet mandatory under fault tolerance below a sharp algebraic price, with \(t_c(2)=3+2\sqrt2\) and \(m t_c(m)\to2\). These are structural consequences of a motivated resilient design problem, not a renamed basic eigenvalue identity; the result need not solve general robust graphs to be useful.
